mapper.sql: SELECT BALANCE_SHEET_ID, STATEMENT_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REPORT_DATE, DATA_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, CURRENT_ASSETS, CASH_AND_EQUIVALENTS, SHORT_TERM_INVESTMENTS, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE, PREPAYMENTS, OTHER_RECEIVABLES, INVENTORY, OTHER_CURRENT_ASSETS, NON_CURRENT_ASSETS, LONG_TERM_INVESTMENTS, FIXED_ASSETS, INTANGIBLE_ASSETS, GOODWILL, DEFERRED_TAX_ASSETS, OTHER_NON_CURRENT_ASSETS, TOTAL_ASSETS, CURRENT_LIABILITIES, SHORT_TERM_BORROWINGS, ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE, ADVANCE_RECEIPTS, ACCRUED_EXPENSES, OTHER_PAYABLES, CURRENT_PORTION_LONG_TERM_DEBT, OTHER_CURRENT_LIABILITIES, NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES, LONG_TERM_BORROWINGS, BONDS_PAYABLE, DEFERRED_TAX_LIABILITIES, OTHER_NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES, TOTAL_LIABILITIES, OWNERS_EQUITY, SHARE_CAPITAL, CAPITAL_RESERVES, RETAINED_EARNINGS, OTHER_COMPREHENSIVE_INCOME, MINORITY_INTERESTS, TOTAL_LIABILITIES_AND_EQUITY, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, CURRENT_RATIO, QUICK_RATIO, EQUITY_MULTIPLIER, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO, TANGIBLE_NET_WORTH_DEBT_RATIO, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DELETED, VERSION FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA
mapper.select: WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR DESC, REPORT_PERIOD DESC

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, TOTAL_ASSETS, CURRENT_ASSETS, NON_CURRENT_ASSETS, ROUND(CURRENT_ASSETS / TOTAL_ASSETS * 100, 2) as currentAssetRatio, ROUND(NON_CURRENT_ASSETS / TOTAL_ASSETS * 100, 2) as nonCurrentAssetRatio, FIXED_ASSETS, INTANGIBLE_ASSETS, ROUND(FIXED_ASSETS / TOTAL_ASSETS * 100, 2) as fixedAssetRatio, ROUND(INTANGIBLE_ASSETS / TOTAL_ASSETS * 100, 2) as intangibleAssetRatio FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, TOTAL_LIABILITIES, CURRENT_LIABILITIES, NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES, ROUND(CURRENT_LIABILITIES / TOTAL_LIABILITIES * 100, 2) as currentLiabilityRatio, ROUND(NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES / TOTAL_LIABILITIES * 100, 2) as nonCurrentLiabilityRatio, SHORT_TERM_BORROWINGS, LONG_TERM_BORROWINGS, ROUND((SHORT_TERM_BORROWINGS + LONG_TERM_BORROWINGS) / TOTAL_LIABILITIES * 100, 2) as borrowingRatio FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, CURRENT_RATIO, QUICK_RATIO, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO, CASE WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 2.0 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 1.0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as liquidityLevel, CASE WHEN ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.6 THEN 'LOW' WHEN ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.8 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'HIGH' END as leverageLevel FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT DATA_STATUS, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY DATA_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 100000000000 THEN 'SUPER_LARGE' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 10000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 1000000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 100000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END as assetScale, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(TOTAL_ASSETS) as avgTotalAssets, MAX(TOTAL_ASSETS) as maxTotalAssets, MIN(TOTAL_ASSETS) as minTotalAssets FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 100000000000 THEN 'SUPER_LARGE' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 10000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 1000000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS >= 100000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END ORDER BY avgTotalAssets DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, AVG(TOTAL_ASSETS) as avgTotalAssets, AVG(CURRENT_RATIO) as avgCurrentRatio, AVG(ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO) as avgAssetLiabilityRatio, COUNT(CASE WHEN CURRENT_RATIO < 1.0 THEN 1 END) as lowLiquidityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO > 0.8 THEN 1 END) as highLeverageCount, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as statisticsTime FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, AVG(TOTAL_ASSETS) as avgTotalAssets, AVG(CURRENT_RATIO) as avgCurrentRatio, AVG(ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO) as avgAssetLiabilityRatio, COUNT(CASE WHEN CURRENT_RATIO < 1.0 THEN 1 END) as lowLiquidityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO > 0.8 THEN 1 END) as highLeverageCount, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as statisticsTime FROM BALANCE_SHEET_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE BALANCE_SHEET_DATA SET DATA_STATUS = #{dataStatus}, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE BALANCE_SHEET_ID IN
#{id}
AND DELETED = 0

UPDATE BALANCE_SHEET_DATA SET ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO = CASE WHEN TOTAL_ASSETS > 0 THEN ROUND(TOTAL_LIABILITIES / TOTAL_ASSETS * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_RATIO = CASE WHEN CURRENT_LIABILITIES > 0 THEN ROUND(CURRENT_ASSETS / CURRENT_LIABILITIES, 2) ELSE NULL END, QUICK_RATIO = CASE WHEN CURRENT_LIABILITIES > 0 THEN ROUND((CURRENT_ASSETS - INVENTORY) / CURRENT_LIABILITIES, 2) ELSE NULL END, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO = CASE WHEN OWNERS_EQUITY > 0 THEN ROUND(TOTAL_LIABILITIES / OWNERS_EQUITY, 2) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE BALANCE_SHEET_ID = #{balanceSheetId} AND DELETED = 0
